name: sshi_fbr_zener
rationale: The reference FBR fails due to diode drops (too low for S2, S4) and lack of regulation (too high for S3). I am adding a Parallel-SSHI (Synchronous Switching Harvesting on Inductor) circuit consisting of an inductor L1 and a switch S1. This flips the voltage across the piezo capacitance Cp at every peak, effectively increasing the voltage delivered to the rectifier and improving energy extraction. To fix the overvoltage in S3, a Zener diode (DZ33) is added as a clamp on the output node. This combination should raise Vout for weak conditions and cap it for strong ones.
